verdict.rationale: Meltano has a public GitHub repository (github.com/meltano/meltano), and community sources describe it as open source with code you can read and change. First-party docs call it self-hostable and "free forever." missing for 10: the specific open-source license is not named in the evidence, and no first-party docs page explicitly states the license or where the source lives.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Meltano and Pipelinewise are open source projects someone built for themselves but are sharing. You can play with it and change the code
Meltano is open source, self-hosted, CLI-first, debuggable, and extensible.
Own every part of your data infrastructure, on your own servers, free forever.
